notes: Account summary: mid-stage fintech (payments/chargeback analytics). Evaluated Redwood Dedicated for reranking + support-chat. Primary ask: predictable latency for fraud scoring pipeline + strict data residency.
Business driver: reduce manual review by 40% via reranking and chat triage. Tight unit-cost target: <$0.20 per 1k inference-equivalent (normalized cost), otherwise not ROI-positive.

POC recap (Dec 2025 - Jan 2026): full-week POC on us + 2-week beta. Achieved throughput target but p95 latency at 120ms (target 75ms) on our config; team wants 50-75ms range for real-time fraud decisions.

Pricing discussion: Redwood proposal required a 3-month reserved commit (heavy GPU pool) with estimated committed spend ~$180k/mo to hit latency/throughput SLOs. Procurement: "can't justify that size given runway".

Unit economics pain: finance modeled per-token and per-GPU cost; without additional batching/cache changes, per-decision cost ~3x their internal threshold. They pushed back hard on commit size and sustained spend.

Competitive dynamic: ModelCo offered a hybrid (distilled reranker on cheaper instances + burst to higher-capacity) at ~40% lower run-rate. Engineering quote from lead: 'the mixed approach looks cheaper and gets us close enough on latency.'

Security/compliance: security team ran vendor questionnaire. Main blockers: KMS/HSM key ownership for private deployment and formal data residency attestations. Redwood security FAQ link shared but procurement wants signed addendum.
Champion churn: product lead (internal champion) left in Jan; remaining sponsor is VP of Ops who is cost-sensitive and has competing initiatives.

Recent timeline:
- 2025-12-03: kickoff call (Samira, Ethan, Sapphire Eng + Prod). Collected requirements; agreed POC scope.
- 2025-12-15: Fireflies transcript ff-2026-01-14-7b9c0a created; demo of sample reranking pipeline.
- 2026-01-10: POC metrics delivered; p95 latency ~120ms, avg cost per decision above target. Shared optimization suggestions (quantization, caching) with estimated 25-40% cost reduction potential.
- 2026-01-22: Procurement review — pushback on commit size and legal requests around KMS. Asked for lower-commit plan or month-to-month option.
- 2026-02-05: Competitor pricing arrived (ModelCo), procurement favored cheaper hybrid until Q3 budget revisit.
- 2026-02-18: Final sync — procurement confirmed budget freeze for new infrastructure; asked Redwood to submit trimmed proposal for future consideration. Samira marked account as hold.

Key quotes/notes from stakeholders:
- VP Ops: 'We like the perf, but not at that price or commit.'
- Eng lead: 'If we can do 30% cost reduction with caching+quant, this becomes interesting again.'
- Procurement: 'Need monthly flex or much smaller reserved bucket; can't lock $180k/mo.'

Open items we proposed before hold:
- Lower-commit plan: 1-month rolling + auto-scale with soft-SLA (higher price for burst) — Redwood to price.
- Technical playbook: run focused quantization + KV prefix caching on reranker path; expected to cut per-decision token compute by ~25% (Ethan to deliver feasibility doc).
- Security addendum draft for KMS/residency (legal to review) — RD to escalate with security team.

Next steps (realistic): hold until Q3 (June) budget refresh. If Redwood can show trimmed pricing + validated cost-reduction plan (benchmarks) then re-engage. No active champion — rely on procurement to re-open.
